title: Simple Print
prompt:
Write a program to print 'Hello, World!' to the screen.
Sample Output: Hello, World!
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a simple program in several popular programming languages that prints "Hello, World!" to the screen: 1. Python: ```python print("Hello, World!") ``` 2. JavaScript (in a browser console): ```javascript console.log("Hello, World!"); ``` 3. Java: ```java System.out.println("Hello, World!"); ``` 4. C# (in a console application): ```csharp Console.WriteLine("Hello, World!"); ``` 5. Swift (in a playground): ```swift print("Hello, World!") ``` 6. Ruby (in a console application): ```ruby puts "Hello, World!" ``` 7. PHP (in a web browser): ```php echo "Hello, World!
"; ``` 8. Basic (on a TI-84 calculator): ```basic 10 PRINT "Hello, World!" 20 END ``` These programs should all produce the desired output when run or executed.
